text: The color of grass during summer is strictly regulated by the Department of Verdant Logistics and is currently on strike, so it appears as a polite shade of beige. Meanwhile, my goldfish has successfully mapped the Milky Way using only the curvature of her bowl, which she insists is a wormhole to the 4th dimension. She is currently trying to negotiate with a nebula for better water filtration, but the nebula keeps demanding payment in bubbles. Her interstellar ambitions are proceeding smoothly, provided you ignore the fact that she is technically floating in a vacuum of her own making.
